tool.gpu_list.title: List GPUs
tool.gpu_list.description: Read-only listing of local GPUs (vendor / model / driver). Probes NVIDIA (nvidia-smi), AMD (rocm-smi), Intel (intel_gpu_top) in order; missing optional dependencies are skipped, and a fully-missing set returns an empty list with a note rather than an error.
tool.gpu_status.title: GPU Status
tool.gpu_status.description: Read-only GPU utilization / memory / temperature / power. Returns the full measurement set. Across vendors the same-named fields are NOT equivalent (NVIDIA=SM%, AMD=GFX%, Intel=Render/3D busy%; see tool description).
tool.gpu_processes.title: GPU Processes
tool.gpu_processes.description: Read-only listing of processes currently using a GPU (PID / name / VRAM). NVIDIA gives exact PID→GPU mapping; AMD rocm-smi --showpids gives count, not indices; Intel intel_gpu_top clients give engine busy%, not VRAM.
tool.gpu_memory.title: GPU Memory
tool.gpu_memory.description: Read-only per-GPU memory breakdown (total/used/free, MiB) plus processes mappable to that GPU. AMD units are bytes (B) internally divided by 1024²; Intel intel_gpu_top does not expose VRAM totals.
